# Interpolation Calculator

> A free, browser-based interpolation calculator. It estimates values between known data points using linear, logarithmic or double (bilinear) interpolation and shows every step of the working. Calculations run client-side; inputs are never sent to a server. Maintained as an independent project; contact code.sudeepto@gmail.com.

## Calculators and guides

- [Interpolation Calculator](https://interpcalc.com/): all three methods in one tool, with worked examples and FAQ
- [Linear interpolation calculator](https://interpcalc.com/linear-interpolation-calculator/): two known points, one target x
- [Logarithmic interpolation calculator](https://interpcalc.com/logarithmic-interpolation-calculator/): for data that is linear in ln(x)
- [Bilinear (double) interpolation calculator](https://interpcalc.com/bilinear-interpolation-calculator/): four corner values of a 2D table
- [Steam table interpolation](https://interpcalc.com/steam-table-interpolation-calculator/): single and double interpolation for steam tables
- [Extrapolation calculator](https://interpcalc.com/extrapolation-calculator/): extending a line beyond known points
- [Interpolation formula](https://interpcalc.com/interpolation-formula/): derivation and weighted-average form
- [Inverse interpolation calculator](https://interpcalc.com/inverse-interpolation-calculator/): finding x for a given y
